features: Uninterrupted internet during power cuts: Cuzor Mini UPS Pro delivers up to 8 hours of back up with 3×2900mAh heavy-duty EV-grade lithium-ion cells, keeping your WiFi router and internet connection running without interruption during power outages. It is like a power bank for your router

Works with all 12V routers up to 3A: Cuzor Mini UPS Pro is compatible with all 12V routers and supports 12V0.5A, 12V1A, 12V1.5A, 12V2A, 12V2.5A and 12V3A router power ratings, making it a reliable WiFi UPS for home and office use

1-year replacement warranty with doorstep support: Hassle-free 1-year replacement warranty with free pickup and drop, ensuring dependable performance and long-term peace of mind for your Cuzor Mini UPS Pro

Replaceable battery for long-term use: Built for easy battery replacement so you don’t need to replace the entire unit when battery performance drops, offering a durable and cost-effective router UPS for everyday use
Zero lag switching, no internet drop: Instant power switching ensures your internet stays connected without resets or lag during power cuts, ideal for work, streaming, and uninterrupted browsing

Supports router, modem & broadband connections: Cuzor Mini UPS Pro works seamlessly with WiFi routers, modems, ONU, ONT and other optical fiber connections, providing consistent back up for internet devices. It support ISPs like Airtel XStream, Jio Fiber, Act, Hathway as well as router models like Nokia, TPLink, TPLink Deco, D-Link, Tenda and many more. Not compatible with AirFiber (PoE) setups that require an outdoor antenna unit
Easy & quick installation: Simple plug-and-play setup gets you up and running in under 30 seconds without any technical expertise
Top safety features for router & modem: Ensures safety from under voltage, overcharging, deep discharging – protects your WiFi router and broadband devices
